title: iodes ovalis var. vitiginea
intro: Iodes ovalis var. vitiginea, commonly known as the Chinese goldenseal, is a plant species belonging to the family Celastraceae. The plant has been traditionally used in medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect the body from oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Iodes ovalis var. vitiginea include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity against various pathogens. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include berberine, palmatine, and epiberberine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
